scope: English certification discovery, retired exam notices, original current-version practice, study guidance and related question links
release: Local changes only. No commit, push, hosted regression or deployment requested or performed.

preservation.policy: Append seven exams and seven question groups. Preserve every existing catalog entry, question payload, URL, exam identity, choice identity and saved-progress namespace. Verify prior content using the SHA-256 snapshots in web/content/certifications-2026-10.manifest.json.
preservation.seo: Retired pages keep their canonical URLs and sitemap entries, with explicit retired-archive titles and descriptions. New exam sets and the study guide enter the sitemap. No redirect from an old question to a different exam.

discovery.behavior: Exclude retired exams from default English cards; offer an explicit archive checkbox and a separate server-rendered archive directory. Preserve archived favorites. Show retirement context above practice settings, including generic /en/test routes.

content.format: Original English single-best-answer scenarios with rationale, distractor explanations and official objective references. Focused topic drills, not complete exam coverage, performance-based simulations or score predictions.
content.popularPageLinks: AWS Developer, AWS Solutions Architect, AZ-900, CCNA 200-301, ENCOR, A+ Core 2 and Cloud Practitioner gain related study/question links. Retired popular pages gain replacement or explicitly related paths without relabeling their questions.

officialEvidence.finding: 200-125, 300-101 and 300-115 last day to test: February 23, 2020. Cisco lists 200-301 for CCNA; it does not list ENCOR as a one-for-one replacement for ROUTE or SWITCH.
Microsoft's published transitions include AZ-103 to AZ-104, AZ-300 to AZ-303 and AZ-301 to AZ-304.

MS-102 scheduled retirement: November 30, 2026. Do not expand it as a long-lived replacement for MS-100 without further review.
MS-100 and MS-101 transitioned to MS-102; the announcement updated their retirement timing to September 30, 2023.
Remaining MCSA/MCSD/MCSE exams retired January 31, 2021; the indexed official notice includes 70-740.

Official English N10-009 objectives document available from CompTIA Japan.
